title: Japanese-Style Flatbread with Deodeok and Syrian
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Middle Eastern flavors featuring deodeok and syrian flatbread.
instructions: Cut the yeasty flatbread into 1-inch squares.
Mix crushed syrian flatbread with sliced deodeok and root in a bowl.
Add the flatbread squares to the bowl and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the flatbread is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
